title: Persona 5 Royal
provenance: Reported by ry-diffusion (highball-db#22, 2026-09-12): M5, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.7 then 0.9.9, D3DMetal on engine x64-crossover26.3-r7 rated 5 of 5 after 6 minutes on medium graphics, then DXMT on engine x64-crossover26.3-r8 running in Shibuya at 26 fps, 1280x800 windowed, on a Mac the reporter says was throttling in the heat. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: DirectX 11. Needs the CrossOver-tree engine: the reporter says the Sikarugir (Wine 10) engines do not run it. The recipe asks for x64-crossover26.3-r8, which the reporter found more stable than r7 while the game loads. Mode: D3DMetal is the one rated 5 of 5 (on r7). DXMT: on r7, with DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1 set to get a window, the reporter's Mac kernel-panicked (a watchdog panic, macOS's GPU driver going down); on r8 the reporter says DXMT runs, 26 fps in Shibuya at 1280x800 on a throttling M5, and the panic did not recur. The panic's cause was not measured, and whether r8's fiber slot change is what removed it is the reporter's inference, not a measurement. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: On engine r7 with DXMT and DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1 the whole Mac kernel-panicked (reported on an M5, macOS 27.0)
knownIssues.cause: not measured; the panic log names the watchdog timer, which is what fires when the GPU driver stops responding. The reporter says it did not recur on engine r8 with DXMT
knownIssues.fix: the recipe asks for engine r8 and sets D3DMetal, the mode the reporter rated; DXMT on r8 is reported working

knownIssues.symptom: Does not run on the Sikarugir (Wine 10) engines
knownIssues.fix: the recipe asks for engine x64-crossover26.3-r8
